changes: Gozero stdin/stdout bridge with CPU candidate verification
Pinned qpow-math resolved from a local copy of the identical chain commit
Split Apple Poseidon2 external/internal round loops and fixed S-box lane indices; exact arithmetic preserved
Checked end-of-range increment prevents repeating U512::MAX
Worker supports bounded batches up to 1048576; optional adaptive host dispatch
CRLF normalized to LF for shell scripts and patch inputs
Upstream pool-binding helper patch applied in its isolated build copy
NA admission is restricted to supported Apple10+ devices; all SG comparisons are retained
Explicit NA overrides obey the same hardware capability check
Kryptex submit includes the authorized worker name
Measured base Apple M3 SG profile: BK32 PF0, zero padding, fixed transcript switch; all other devices keep original geometry
Effective tuning parameters and modified source included in cache/G3 admission identity

notes: QTC uses Goldilocks Poseidon2; it is different from NOID Poseidon2b.
QTC pool adapter is independently implemented and uses observed Kryptex login/job/submit framing.
No code from the restricted-license KanQ miner is included.
PRL cert-v3 jobs were observed on Kryptex; a successful build alone does not prove pool acceptance.
Existing NOID GUI and its service fee controller are unchanged.
